evidence.quote: Moisture Vapor Transmission                         0.02 perms max: FSK, AP, & Ultra
AP (All Purpose). The AP or All Purpose facing is an ASJ comprised of white kraft bonded to aluminum foil, reinforced with fiber glass yarn and laminated with fire-resistant adhesive to kraft paper.
Types 813, 814, 815 and 817 provide neat square corners for an excellent finished appearance on duct and equipment systems.
On systems operating below ambient temperatures, all seams should be tightly sealed with quality ASJ, foil, FSK or Ultra tapes depending on the desired finish.

round.product: Micro-Flex® large-diameter pipe & tank fiberglass wrap
round.thickness_note: Stretch-out chart columns 1†, 1½, 2, 2½, 3, 3½, 4 in; 1 in carries a footnote and is left out here. JM prints no R-values: R = thickness ÷ k at 75°F (0.24).

evidence.quote: Micro-Flex large-diameter pipe and tank wrap is a 2.5 pcf (40.1 kg/m 3) density product made from high-temperature, semi-rigid fiberglass blanket bonded to a flexible facing.

Micro-Flex can be installed indoors & outdoors depending on the application. Micro-Flex does require a weather barrier cladding such as aluminum jacketing or polyvinyl chloride (PVC) jacketing to protect it from the elements when installed outdoors.
application on rounded shapes such as pipes, tanks, ducts, vessels and other similar round and irregular shapes.

evidence.location: p1 Physical Properties, Water Vapor Permeance

outdoor_jacket.summary: Outdoors the board goes under an aluminum jacket: UFGS 23 07 00 calls for ASTM B209 H14 aluminum, 0.016 in minimum; round duct outdoors lapped at least 3 in with bands at the laps and at most 12 in apart; rectangular duct outdoors a metal jacket secured with screws. Micro-Flex outdoors needs weather-barrier cladding such as aluminum (U65). JM's own rooftop-duct board is XSPECT ISOfoam APF (polyiso) under Cross-Flo jacketing; not used here.
